description: This PHP source file defines the class UserMigrationStatus, which tracks and reports the status of user data migration processes including processed counts, migration outcomes, error handling, and details. It also references the UserMigrationStatsDetail class for detailed migration info.

classes.name: UserMigrationStatus
classes.description: A class for tracking the progress and reporting details of user migration operations, including counters for processed, migrated, skipped, error counts, and detailed migration info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of UserMigrationStatus with optional counters and details.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns the array of UserMigrationStatsDetail objects providing detailed migration info.

methods.name: isMigrated
methods.description: Determines if the migration process has been successfully completed without errors and not in dry run mode.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the migration is currently a dry run.

methods.name: setDryRun
methods.description: Sets the dry run flag for the migration process.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Adds a migration detail and updates counters based on the detail's type and user info.

methods.name: getProcessed
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed items.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Generates a string summary of the migration status, including counters and detailed info.
